title: On a phone the representative fields look as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • The design canvas is open in another tab at page 6, boards 6.2 to 6.7.
    For example: the canvas is https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open on a phone (a touch screen with no mouse pointer), card expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Compare the field with board 6.2.
  2. Tap the + , add Parts, and compare with board 6.6.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the field, its dropdown arrow and the + (32 px) are all shown without hover.
  • Step 2: both fields with their arrows shown, and the remove x (32 px) beside Parts.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11267 (Story 3, Set the representatives on a phone); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S3-R2, S3-R4, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, page 6, boards 6.2 to 6.7, used for the picture to compare against. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

The design shows no arrow at rest on a phone (boards 6.2 and 6.6). The PRD says the arrow always shows on a touch screen; this case follows the PRD, and the difference is on the product owner's question list.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R2: “The + and remove x buttons are always shown, at the same 32px size (S2-R1, S2-R8), and work as on a desktop (Story 2).”
  • S3-R4: “Nothing in the fields or the buttons depends on hover. On a touch screen the Sales Representative fields always show their dropdown arrow, as the + and remove x buttons always do. Lead Technician and Service Advisor keep today's behavior, where the arrow shows once the field is tapped.”
